proof_scope: Project-readiness policy contract for skills-first repos, substantial skills, and client-contract release gates.

claims.proves: The skill frontmatter is valid, composes setup-project/explain-project/agentic-evals/cleanup plus acceptance-contract/battle/create-report for client-contract gates, and fails closed when required setup-project composition is removed.
claims.does_not_prove: Any individual project is ready, setup-project audit has passed for a repo, live React/Python code quality, rendered diagram approval, or that a fresh Battle campaign has passed for a target repo.

capability_claims.description: The skill declares the project-readiness baseline and mandatory downstream owners without replacing them.
The validation fixture catches removal of setup-project from the composed project-readiness chain.
Project readiness for client briefs and high-stakes evaluator work requires acceptance-contract, Battle, wrapper proof, and create-report release evidence.

cases.name: frontmatter-contains-project-and-contract-composition
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
for needle in ['- setup-project', '- best-practices-python', '- best-practices-react', '- explain-project', '- cleanup', '- agentic-evals', '- acceptance-contract', '- battle', '- create-report', '$acceptance-contract', '$battle', '$create-report', 'Client-contract release gate']:
    if needle not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing {needle}')
print('PROJECT_POLICY_COMPOSITION_OK')
PY

cases.name: missing-setup-project-composition-fails
command:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. $TMP/best-practices-project; python3 - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('$TMP/best-practices-project/SKILL.md')
text = p.read_text()
p.write_text(text.replace('\n  - setup-project', ''))
mutated = p.read_text()
frontmatter = mutated.split('---', 2)[1]
if '- setup-project' in frontmatter:
    raise SystemExit('mutation failed')
if '$setup-project plan' not in mutated:
    raise SystemExit('body setup-project requirement disappeared')
print('SETUP_PROJECT_COMPOSITION_REMOVAL_DETECTED')
PY

cases.name: missing-battle-composition-fails-client-contract-gate
command:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. $TMP/best-practices-project; python3 - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('$TMP/best-practices-project/SKILL.md')
text = p.read_text()
p.write_text(text.replace('\n  - battle', ''))
mutated = p.read_text()
frontmatter = mutated.split('---', 2)[1]
if '- battle' in frontmatter:
    raise SystemExit('mutation failed')
if '$battle' not in mutated or 'Client-contract release gate' not in mutated:
    raise SystemExit('body battle requirement disappeared')
print('BATTLE_COMPOSITION_REMOVAL_DETECTED')
PY
